LightningComponentBundle.description: Generic OmniScript Review & Summary with collapsible sections, disclosure, and EN/FR labels. Reusable across OmniScripts.

property.name: sectionKeys
property.label: Section Keys
property.description: Comma-separated OmniScript step keys to review (e.g. FilingHeader,PlanData). Leave blank to auto-detect.

property.name: skipKeys
property.label: Skip Keys
property.description: Comma-separated root keys to ignore when auto-detecting sections.

property.name: showDisclosure
property.label: Show Disclosure
property.description: Show disclosure text and attestation checkbox.

property.name: requireAttestation
property.label: Require Attestation
property.description: Block Next/Submit until attestation is checked.

property.name: labelPrefix
property.label: Label Prefix
property.description: Custom Label prefix used to resolve field/section titles (e.g. PP_).
